title: Deterministic construction
statement: For a small-bias Fourier input, its construction is the deterministic small-bias algorithm applied to the associated generator input. The resulting executable construction has output dimension equal to that input's output dimension.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying bias input has output dimension $n>0$.
Twice the bias numerator is at most the bias denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
caveat: The deterministic algorithm's construction is not defined in the supplied statement, so its output cannot be described more explicitly.
